GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldDomainDoctrinePr.label: conquest doctrine
GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldDomainDoctrinePr.description: This domain favors overwhelming direct assaults. Abduction and destructive strikes remain possible when the colony presents a suitable opportunity, but military conquest is its dominant answer to resistance.

GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldDomainDoctrinePr.label: enslavement doctrine
GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldDomainDoctrinePr.description: This domain prizes living captives and useful hosts. It favors abduction when the colony and available forces make capture plausible, while retaining direct assault as a dependable fallback.

GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldDomainDoctrinePr.label: scorched-earth doctrine
GateRimSG1.Goauld.GoauldDomainDoctrinePr.description: This domain prefers to break defiance by ruining infrastructure and supplies. Destructive strikes are favored when the colony is developed enough to present a worthwhile target, but direct assault remains available.
